verdict.rationale: 2D workflow is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions sprites, tilemaps, or 2D physics. The documented physics is ammo.js/Bullet with rigidbody and collision components, and the engine is consistently described as a 3D engine, so there is no evidence of a first-class 2D workflow.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought
